title: v1.10 M5 signal-skewed two-sided quoting on the 7 real XNAS ITCH sessions (exploratory, IN-SAMPLE)
status_of_data: IN-SAMPLE. The 7 sessions (2019-01-30, 2019-03-27, 2019-07-30, 2019-08-30, 2019-10-30, 2019-12-30, 2020-01-30; AAPL, MSFT, QQQ) were already used to design, fit and select every alpha. This is exploratory; a positive result only motivates a fresh out-of-sample test. The 2026 holdout (2026-05-15, 2026-05-18) is SPENT for EQ01/05/10 and is not used.

cells.role: control: no-skew gamma-only quoter on every symbol (expected_return = 0)

decisions: A 1 s grid: the first continuous-trading feature row (is_trading_v1 == 1, is_auction_v1 != 1, is_halt_v1 != 1; multi7 features) of each second from 09:31:00 to 15:59:00 New York time. Skewed cells: expected_return = LinearAlpha.score() (the pinned clipped port path) of the alpha fitted on sessions strictly before the test session, pooled over the alpha's universe; the cell runs on the symbols of that universe. Control: the same grid on all 3 symbols with expected_return = 0 and alpha_weight = 0.
walk_forward: Sessions in date order. Session 1 (2019-01-30) is warm-up only (calibration, alpha fit); the test sessions are the 6 later ones. Alpha fit on sessions strictly before; the calibration (latency table, impact, adverse-selection floor) is the PREVIOUS session's for that symbol.
calibration: estimate_calibration per session and symbol (the python -m iap.execution.calibration code path) with the ASSUMED parametric latency injected exactly as the maker study (research/maker_real/prereg.json): reused read-only from data/real/maker_real/calib/<session>_<symbol>.json when present, else computed identically by this driver into its own output directory.

latency_ASSUMED.note: ASSUMED, not measured: ITCH carries no receive stamp.

fees: configs of the multi7 dataset: XNAS taker 0.003 USD/share, maker rebate 0.002 USD/share (indicative list prices).
statistic: Per cell: per test session the net P&L in USD (after rebates, taker fees and impact, flattened at the close) summed over the cell's symbols. Session-clustered mean over the 6 test sessions, Student-t CI with (sessions - 1) df. Reported descriptively: the P&L decomposition (spread_captured, markout, inventory_pnl, flatten_cost, rebates, fees, impact), fills and fill rates, inventory (max, mean, time at limit), flatten stats, net per quote fill in bps of notional, sharpe_per_day of the session nets, and the paired per-session difference skewed minus control on the same symbols.
verdict_rule: Quoting edge EXISTS for a cell iff the session-clustered mean net USD per session > 0 AND its CI excludes 0 at the Bonferroni level over the 4 cells (two-sided 0.05/4) AND at least 4 of the 6 test sessions have quote fills. Anything else = no demonstrated quoting edge. Skew HELPS for an alpha cell (secondary, descriptive, same Bonferroni level) iff the session-clustered mean of (skewed - control on the same symbols) > 0 with its Bonferroni CI excluding 0. In-sample: EXISTS reads 'worth an out-of-sample test', never 'profitable'. No parameter is tuned after seeing results; there is no sweep.
sampling: Full sessions (decisions 09:31-15:59, events to the close); one (session, symbol) unit at a time.
